headline: Dave Marsh, Rock Critic Who Loved Springsteen and Hated the Dead, Dies at 76
context: A passionately opinionated veteran of Creem and Rolling Stone, he was part of a generation of writers who influenced how the world saw the golden age of rock.

sources.name: The New York Times
